findings.current: We get two or three escape attempts every year without fail.
findings.defect: The Korean says two or three people attempt to escape each year, not that there are two or three attempts. The translation changes what is being counted.
findings.rationale: “탈옥 시도하는 놈들도 일 년에 두세 명씩은 꼭 나오는 편이고” counts people (명), not escape attempts.
findings.replacement: Two or three people try to escape every year without fail.

summary: One minor quantity-unit mismatch: the source counts people attempting escape, while the translation counts attempts.
